_last = None
def onFrameEnd(frame):
    global _last
    now = absTime.seconds
    if _last is None:
        _last = now
        return
    delta = max(0.0, min(1.0, now - _last))
    _last = now
    if delta > 0.0:
        op('callbacks').module.advance(delta)
    return
